notes: Microstock is registered as a subproduct of Archivd (`'parent' => 'Archivd'` in config/domains.php): `domain:remove` refuses Archivd while this domain is still registered, so remove Microstock first.
Without --purge-data the 10 migrations stay; drop them by hand once the tables are gone.

Service catalog: the `microstock.plan.free`, `microstock.addon.workspace-slot.monthly` and `microstock.addon.ai-credits.5` rows go with the `services` purge; their service_prices / service_entitlements rows cascade from it.
AI connections: the `microstock-vision` / `microstock-thinking` rows in ai_connections go with the consumer bindings.

`database/seeders/data/ai-connections.local.php` is gitignored machine-local config, so it is not scanned and not recorded: drop its `microstock-vision` / `microstock-thinking` keys by hand if your checkout has one.
Queue workers: retire the `microstock-collection-*`, `microstock-solo*` and `microstock-upload` lanes from the worker order and the scheduler.

Kernel seams (moved out in 1.1): the `microstock.*` settings, menu nodes and AI consumer rows are published by `App\Domain\Microstock\Support\*` contributors, so no package file is edited on removal — deleting `app/Domain/Microstock` and its provider unregisters them. `ImportLegacyEnvCommand` iterates `ai.consumers`, so its literal cases are gone too.

The `ignore` section is the reviewed hand-edit list: Archivd views/services, the Inference usage analytics, the Service catalog helpers, the kernel seam guards and the shared Settings registry each name the exact edit and line.
